_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The night is long, and the earth is dark.
But the Spirit is moving over the waters.
God said, Let there be light.
And the light has never gone out.
Through the sea, through the fire, God has brought us.
His steadfast love endures forever.
Come, let us keep watch for the morning.
Christ our light is dawning. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Look — one small flame in all this dark, and then another, and another, until the whole room is warm with light.
His steadfast love endures forever.
This is the night God hovered over the deep and spoke, the night the sea split open and our ancestors walked through on dry ground.
His steadfast love endures forever.
This is the night the waters that drown us became the waters that raise us, and we came up new.
His steadfast love endures forever.
So keep watch until the sky goes gray and then gold, for the stone is already rolling back.
His steadfast love endures forever. Christ is risen, Alleluia!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: One flame in the dark, and the dark gives way.
Christ our light is dawning.
Through water and fire God has carried us here.
Christ our light is dawning.
The stone is rolling back; the morning is near.
Christ our light is dawning.
Come, let us keep watch for the risen Lord.
We watch for the morning. Amen.
